title: policy.json: store
description: The private store's remote (design 0003, section 11). It is committed so a fresh cloud container finds the remote without anyone running a command. The address is not a secret: no password goes in it, and credentials come from the session's own git access. A machine can override it with `hitld store remote set` (kept in that machine's private store, never committed).

remote.description: Where the private store's encrypted bundles are kept between machines.

url.description: The store repository: https://host/owner/repo.git, ssh://git@host/owner/repo.git, user@host:path or an absolute path. Checked when it is used (core/lib/store/remote-git.mjs, checkRemoteUrl): no password, no plain http, no transport helper. Null: no remote is set here.
